notes.title: TRADING CARDS and Points Shop Items are available now!
notes.content:
TRADING CARDS and Points Shop Items are available now!

Hey guys!

We have a great news! Steam Community items (Trading Cards, Emoticons, BGs and Badges) are now available for everyone! 


What do you think about it? Feel free to share your opinion in the comments below!


We really appreciate your help and support in obtaining these trading cards! 


Thank you!
